security_audit.summary: The skill has legitimate read-only Linear project intent, but it requires LINEAR_API_KEY and points users to a .env credential file. Several Markdown backtick findings are false positives, while the Bun command blocks and missing audited implementation files remain real risks.

remediation.suggestion: Document the minimum required Linear token scope, never print the key, and avoid passing it through command arguments.
Read only LINEAR_API_KEY from .env and warn users not to store unrelated secrets in the same file.
Validate all user-supplied filters and project names before command execution, and avoid shell interpolation.
Include the referenced list-projects and get-project implementation files in the package or remove the command instructions.

content.user_title: Review Linear Projects from the CLI
content.value_statement: Teams need quick Linear project visibility without opening the web app. This skill runs read-only CLI queries for project lists and project details.
actual_capabilities: Lists Linear projects from the command line.
Filters project lists by project lead name.
Limits the number of returned projects.
Gets one project by UUID or partial project name.
Can request JSON output for downstream processing.
limitations: Requires the Bun runtime before commands can run.
Requires a valid LINEAR_API_KEY in the environment or .env file.
Supports read-only project lookup, not project creation or updates.
The audited package does not include the referenced implementation scripts.

use_cases.title: Check Active Work
use_cases.description: List started Linear projects before a planning meeting.

use_cases.title: Find Ownership
use_cases.description: Filter projects by lead to see each owner's current portfolio.

use_cases.title: Inspect One Project
use_cases.description: Retrieve a project by partial name when reviewing a roadmap item.

prompt_templates.title: List Recent Projects
prompt_templates.prompt: List up to 10 Linear projects and show the normal table output.

prompt_templates.title: Filter by Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Show Linear projects with status started and keep the output unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Find Lead Projects
prompt_templates.prompt: List Linear projects led by James Madison and include JSON output only if I ask for it.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Project Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Get the Linear project named Mount Vernon and summarize risks only after showing the command output.

output_examples.input: List started Linear projects with a limit of 10.
output_examples.output: A terminal table showing matching project names, status, lead, and project identifiers.

output_examples.input: Get the Linear project named Mount Vernon.
output_examples.output: A project detail view with the matched project name, status, owner, and related metadata.

output_examples.input: Find projects led by James Madison.
output_examples.output: A filtered project list containing only projects whose lead matches the requested name.

best_practices: Use the lowest-privilege Linear API key that supports project reads.
Review command output directly before asking for extra summarization.
Use exact project names when partial matches could be ambiguous.
anti_patterns: Do not store unrelated secrets in the same .env file.
Do not use this skill for project updates or workflow automation.
Do not share JSON output if it contains private project metadata.

faq.question: Does this skill modify Linear projects?
faq.answer: No. The documented commands are for listing projects and reading one project.

faq.question: What credentials does it need?
faq.answer: It requires LINEAR_API_KEY in the environment or in a .env file.

faq.question: Can it filter projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents filters for status, lead name, result limit, and JSON output.

faq.question: Can it find a project by name?
faq.answer: Yes. The get command accepts a UUID or a partial project name.

faq.question: Which runtime is required?
faq.answer: The skill requires the Bun runtime to run the documented commands.

faq.question: Is the implementation included in this audit?
faq.answer: No. The audited package only includes SKILL.md and skill.json.
